image_description: A side-profile view of a hammerhead shark swimming in dark water. The shark is oriented horizontally, facing left. Its distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible, with eyes at the tips. The body is streamlined and greyish-white, fading into the dark background. The dorsal fin is prominent and triangular/falcate. Pectoral fins are visible. The caudal fin is partially visible but fades into the darkness.

The white underbelly is extremely smooth and uniform, lacking any subtle textural variation or noise that might be expected in a high-fidelity photograph, giving it a slightly 'airbrushed' or synthetic look.
